fields.label: Require Project and Scope on Sales Documents
fields.description: Sales Orders, Delivery Notes and Sales Invoices must carry a Project, and a Scope on every measured line. Insite only checks lines that a Measurement Rule matched, so ordinary sales are not affected.

fields.label: Refuse to Submit Invoices for a Scope With Open Rejections
fields.description: Off, Insite warns and names the open rejections but lets the invoice through. On, it refuses to submit the invoice until each one is reworked, credited or accepted. A draft can always be saved either way, and credit notes are always allowed — raising one is how a rejection is settled.
